notes: v1.11.0 - Where the plugins' time goes: .profile times every callback into a plugin, every scrye.* call out of it and every trigger or alias pattern tried, and prints a line per plugin (script / client calls / matching) and the costliest rows; .profile <text> narrows it, .profile reset starts over. Plugin API 1.25: a colorgrid can be dragged and wheeled (onDrag, onWheel), so a map can be moved and zoomed with the mouse. The companion switches worlds: with more than one character open on the PC, tap the character name on the phone to pick another. Plugins since 1.10.9: 3S Elemental 0.1.0 is new - the Elemental guild HUD (energy, vortex and the reset clock as bars, defences, charges, the gexp to the next level and the pace toward it, every skill against its total with the next cost - click for info, right-click to enhance); 3S Compendium 0.10.1 is new - a hunting log that fills itself in from what you meet and kill, with fight numbers per character, notes and tags, loot and coins, and an Items tab by area with search; 3S Map 1.22.0 zooms the flat map with the wheel and drags it, and Fit shows the whole level; 3S Farmer 1.15.0 rotates between places by hand or by kill quota, leaves m…
